name: Luer Lock Syringe, Sterile
short_description: Sterile syringe with Luer lock connector tip. 1cc, 10cc, and 60cc syringes available.
description:
These sterile syringes with a Luer lock tip offer a secure, leak-resistant connection for precise fluid or fat injection and aspiration. Designed for compatibility with a wide range of needles and cannulas, they support a variety of surgical applications, including fat injection and aspiration.

Each syringe features a transparent barrel with bold graduations for accurate measurement, along with a smooth-glide plunger for controlled handling. The individually wrapped, sterile packaging ensures safety and efficiency in operating rooms, prep areas, and procedure rooms.

Key Features

  • Luer Lock Connector: Ensures a secure fit to prevent leaks or disconnections
  • Clear Barrel with Graduated Markings: Promotes precise dosing and visibility
  • Smooth Plunger Action: Offers consistent resistance for controlled delivery

Applications

  • Liposuction: Ideal for small amounts of lipoaspirate and fat reinjection.

Order the Sterile Luer Lock Syringe today and ensure your team has dependable supplies for the procedure at hand.

Black Diamond™ Rasps

Black & Black Surgical’s Black Diamond™ line uses an exceptionally hard, durable, medical grade carbide alloy that is non-magnetic and non-carcinogenic.

The exclusive patented blend of tungsten carbide in the inserts of these specialty rasps creates an extremely hardened cutting edge, which not only delivers an unsurpassed clean and precise cut, but also translates into reduced patient trauma. As a result of our unique manufacturing process, these instruments maintain their sharpness longer than standard instruments, yielding a money-saving cost/use analysis.

The weight and density of Black Diamond™’s advanced ergonomic styling creates superior comfort in handling and enhanced mobility in performance. The select Black Diamond™ material blend is also non-magnetic with a lower porosity, allowing for more thorough, and less potentially damaging, sterilization.

short_description: Ceramic-coated stainless steel. Double-beveled blades with flattened tips and micro-serrations on the lower blade to prevent tissue slippage. Ergonomically spread shanks.
description:
Ceramic-coated stainless steel. Double-beveled blades with flattened tips and micro-serrations on the lower blade to prevent tissue slippage. Ergonomically spread shanks conform to the normal resting position of the hand, thereby improving control and reducing fatigue.

This special group of delicate serrated scissors is useful for the rapid and precise undermining of face and neck flaps. They feature double-beveled blades, semi-sharpened on the outside edge so they will pass through tissue with less resistance.

The tips of the blades are slightly flattened and tapered for precise dissection and to prevent “buttonholing.” Rapid dissection is accomplished by tensing the skin back and “running” the scissors with the tips spread slightly, thereby creating “channels.” The unique design of the blades will then allow for the efficient interconnecting of these channels for precise facial and neck flaps. name: Emory Endoscopic Plastic Retractor For 10mm Scope, w/Suction, w/Locking Mechanism
short_description: Designed to work optimally with the EndoPlastic Scope, but can be used with standard size 10 mm endoscope.
description:
The Emory Endoscopic Plastic Retractor is designed for ease of use in a broad range of endoscopic procedures such as transaxillary breast augmentation, corrugator and procerus resection, muscle flap harvest, and tissue expander placement.

These minimally invasive instruments, combined with new visualization technology, have made possible revolutionary advances in aesthetic surgery. Ergonomically designed retractors allow single-handed maintenance of subcutaneous pocket, while simultaneously providing traction and counter traction, leaving the dominant hand free for dissection.

These Emory retractors feature special scope guides which will hold the endoscope in position under the blade. Some patterns have incorporated suction which ensures optimal visualization by constant smoke evacuation.

Designed to work optimally with the EndoPlastic Scope, but can be used with standard size 10 mm endoscope.

Extensive dissections such as the breast, trunk, or extremities can easily be done with the larger retractors and the 10 mm endoscope. Endoscopic abdominoplasty is possible with the long blade retractor and electrosurgical dissecting instruments. The narrow retractors are designed for facial aesthetic procedures and are available to accommodate both the 10 mm and 5 mm endoscopes. When incision space is limited, the 5 mm retractor and endoscope are preferred.

name: Gorney-Freeman Facelift Serrated Onyx Scissors
short_description: Double-beveled blades with flattened tips and microserrations on the lower blade to prevent tissue slippage. Ergonomically spread shanks.
description:
Tungsten Carbide. These special scissors were designed to facilitate precise and rapid dissection of facial tissue through small incisions. They feature serrated double-beveled blades, semi-sharpened on the outside edge so they will pass through tissue with less resistance.

The tips of the blades are flattened and tapered for precise dissection and to prevent “buttonholing.” Rapid dissection is accomplished by tensing the skin back and “running” the scissors with the tips spread slightly thereby creating “channels.” The unique design of the blades will then allow for the efficient interconnecting of these channels for precise facial and neck flaps. Spread (open) shanks conform to the normal resting position of the hand thereby improving control and reducing fatigue.

short_description: Adjustable Spot Vorotek™ LED Headlight – Headband, 10Hr Battery Pack, Charger, And Case
description:
In 2011, Vorotek™ launched the Vorotek™ LED HeadLight, providing surgical-quality LED Illumination with complete freedom and mobility. LED illumination is replacing fiber optic lighting systems. The intensity and quality of light matches previous hot “xenon” lights, and not being tethered by a fiber optic cable or power cord is a major innovation & benefit.

FEATURES

  • Adjustable Spot Size – The spot size can be adjusted between 50mm—95 mm, at a distance of 400mm from the front lens, by simply rotating the lens housing
  • Complete Freedom & Mobility – Headlight is not tethered to a fiber optic light source, giving the user freedom of movement
  • Surgical Quality LED Illumination – The compound lens system & high-efficiency LED technology produces:
    • Light intensity of 90,000 Lux up to a brilliant 150,000 Lux
    • Color temperature of 5700 degrees Kelvin
    • Homogenous edge-to-edge beam uniformity
  • Coaxial LED Illumination – The light can be adjusted to align with the user’s visual pathway, allowing shadow-free illumination of the surgical field of view
  • Fully Integrated, Ergonomic Design – Head-worn, lightweight, and hands-free, the fully integrated design ensures that the loupes and illumination stay precisely aligned
  • Dimmable Light – Provides 7 evenly spaced levels of illumination
  • Portable & AC Power Supply – Lithium-ion battery pack provides 7 – 20 hours ““on time”” depending on the illumination level used:
    • Fully charges in 4 hours
    • Charger/AC Power Supply can be used to provide continuous use.

short_description: The Black & Black Vitruvian™ Ultimate Liposuction Aspirator is one of the most powerful, quiet and versatile liposuction aspirators on the market.
description:
The Black & Black Vitruvian™ Ultimate Liposuction Aspirator is one of the most powerful, quiet and versatile liposuction aspirators on the market. Powered by two oil-less, rocking piston vacuum pumps, this machine provides excellent suction power along with quiet operation. Its dual voltage motor can be used with 120V/230V electrical service.

Our Vitruvian™ Ultimate Aspirator is carefully designed for optimal performance, with an upright stance and shopping-cart style handle for ease of mobility. Bright LED vacuum gauges are easy to read. The collection canisters are mounted for ease of viewing during surgery. The single knob control can be adjusted 0 to 29.5 in of Hg vacuum.

  • Large 3″ hospital-grade wheels
  • Dual pneumatic foot-switches
  • Dual-voltage motors – 120V/230V
  • Bright, easy-to-read vacuum gauges
  • Dual motors for optimal performance
  • Quiet operation (50 dB)
  • Easy-to-see collection canisters
  • Extendable pole to hold fluid bags

short_description: For precise elevation of the nasal periosteum/perichondrium.
description:
The Joseph elevator is a trusted instrument for precise elevation of the nasal periosteum and perichondrium during rhinoplasty and other nasal procedures. Measuring 6-1/2″ (16.5cm), featuring a slightly curved tip, providing enhanced access and visibility when working along the natural contours of the nasal framework.

Favored in both cosmetic and reconstructive surgeries, the Joseph elevator allows surgeons to perform controlled tissue dissection while preserving delicate anatomical structures. The sharp edges ensure accurate tissue elevation with minimal trauma to adjacent tissue. Its balanced design and ergonomic handle provide a secure grip and optimal maneuverability throughout the procedure.

Key Features

  • Slightly Curved: Follows nasal anatomy for improved access and visualization
  • Sharp Edges: Enables precise, controlled elevation of periosteum/perichondrium
  • Precision Length: At 6-1/2″, it offers balance and reach for both open and closed rhinoplasty

Applications

  • Nasal Surgery: Ideal for rhinoplasty, septoplasty, and nasal reconstruction where tissue preservation is critical
  • Periosteal Elevation: Used to lift soft tissue layers cleanly from underlying bone or cartilage

Backed by precision engineering and consistent performance, this Joseph elevator is a dependable choice for surgeons who demand quality, control, and reliability.

name: Kaye-Freeman Serrated Supercut Scissors, 7″ (18cm), Curved
short_description: Double-beveled blades with flattened tips and micro-serrations on the lower blade to prevent tissue slippage. Ergonomically spread shanks.
description:
Stainless Steel. Double-beveled blades with flattened tips and micro-serrations on the lower blade to prevent tissue slippage. Ergonomically spread shanks conform to the normal resting position of the hand, thereby improving control and reducing fatigue.

This special group of delicate serrated scissors is useful for the rapid and precise undermining of face and neck flaps. They feature double-beveled blades, semi-sharpened on the outside edge so they will pass through tissue with less resistance.

The tips of the blades are slightly flattened and tapered for precise dissection and to prevent “buttonholing.” Rapid dissection is accomplished by tensing the skin back and “running” the scissors with the tips spread slightly, thereby creating “channels.” The unique design of the blades will then allow for the efficient interconnecting of these channels for precise facial and neck flaps. Spread (open) shanks conform to the normal resting position of the hand thereby improving control and reducing fatigue.

name: Gorney-Freeman Serrated SuperCut Scissors
short_description: Double-beveled blades with flattened tips and micro serrations on the lower blade to prevent tissue slippage. Ergonomically spread shanks.
description:
Stainless Steel. These special scissors were designed to facilitate precise and rapid dissection of facial tissue through small incisions. They feature serrated double-beveled blades, semi-sharpened on the outside edge so they will pass through tissue with less resistance.

The tips of the blades are flattened and tapered for precise dissection and to prevent “buttonholing.” Rapid dissection is accomplished by tensing the skin back and “running” the scissors with the tips spread slightly thereby creating “channels.” The unique design of the blades will then allow for the efficient interconnecting of these channels for precise facial and neck flaps. Spread (open) shanks conform to the normal resting position of the hand thereby improving control and reducing fatigue.

name: Webster Onyx Needle Holder, 4-1/2″ (11.5cm)
short_description: Delicate, popular needle holder. Use with 5-0 or finer suture. (Smooth or 7000 – Jaw)
description:
This delicate and widely favored Webster needle holder features fine tips and a compact 4-1/2″ (11.5cm) length, making it ideal for use in precise, small-field procedures. Designed for use with 5-0 or finer suture, the Webster Onyx Needle Holder is a trusted choice in facial surgeries, including blepharoplasty, rhinoplasty, and facelifts, as well as in neck lifts, breast surgeries, pediatric cases, and hand procedures.

With tungsten carbide jaw inserts, the Webster needle holder delivers excellent grip and durability, even with repeated use. Available with either smooth or 7000 jaws, it adapts to surgeon’s preference while offering secure needle control. The balanced shanks and precisely milled ratchets allow for easy handling and consistent locking action during fine suturing.

Key Features

  • Tungsten Carbide Inserts: These offer superior grip strength and wear resistance for consistent needle handling with fine sutures.
  • Fine, Tapered Tips: Enable access to delicate, confined anatomical spaces with maximum control.
  • Smooth or 7000 Jaw Options: Accommodates surgical preferences and technique for enhanced precision.
  • Precision Ratchet Mechanism: Ensures effortless locking and unlocking with tactile responsiveness.

Applications

  • Facial Surgeries: Ideal for blepharoplasty, rhinoplasty, facelift, and neck lift where finesse and control are vital.
  • Body & Specialized Procedures: Commonly used in breast surgery, pediatric cases, hand surgery, and ophthalmic procedures.

The Webster Onyx Needle Holder is a compact, high-precision instrument that delivers exceptional control, grip, and maneuverability, making it a go-to instrument for any surgical setting.

Add the Webster Onyx to your set for a proven blend of accuracy, durability, and smooth performance.

name: Halstead Mosquito Forceps, 5″ (12.5cm)
short_description: Fine hemostat for facial and hand surgery.
description:
These fine mosquito forceps are a trusted choice for surgeons who require delicate control during facial, hand, breast, or body procedures. Measuring 5″ (12.5cm), they are available with either straight or curved jaws and with or without 1×2 teeth, allowing for tailored tissue handling depending on the surgical site.

The Halstead Mosquito offers a superb grip on small flaps and fragile structures. The precision-balanced shanks and finely machined ratchet mechanism provide smooth, consistent locking and easy release. Whether used for clamping vessels or manipulating tissue, these mosquito forceps deliver accuracy and comfort throughout the procedure.

Key Features

 

  • Fine Jaw Options: Curved or straight jaws, with or without teeth, support a variety of surgical techniques.
  • Balanced Shanks: Designed for ease of use and ergonomic control.
  • Precision Ratchet: Offers secure locking and smooth release for controlled tissue handling.

Applications

  • Facial and Hand Surgery: Preferred for precise hemostasis and tissue manipulation in confined spaces.
  • Body Procedures: Effective in breast and body surgeries where small-caliber instruments are needed.

Compact and versatile, these ring forceps are a staple in any surgical set where precision and delicacy are priorities.

Experience the precision and dependable grip that make the Halstead Mosquito Forceps a surgical essential.

name: Ribbon Retractor, Malleable Blade
short_description: General purpose malleable retractor.
description:
This stainless steel ribbon retractor is a versatile, general-purpose instrument used to gently hold back soft tissue during a wide range of surgical procedures. Its flat, malleable blade can be easily shaped to accommodate specific anatomical contours, making it an ideal choice for body and facial procedures.

Available in a range of blade widths, from 6mm to 100mm, this ribbon retractor provides flexible options to meet the needs of both superficial and deep tissue retraction. Its smooth surface minimizes trauma, while the sturdy construction ensures the blade maintains shape during procedures, yet can be easily reshaped between applications as needed.

Key Features

  • Malleable Design: Allows for patient-specific retraction angles and depths
  • Multiple Blade Widths: Offers a variety of sizes for different surgical procedures and access points
  • Smooth Finish: Minimizes tissue trauma and supports consistent performance

Applications

  • Surgery: Used in body and facial procedures
  • Soft Tissue Retraction: Helps expose underlying structures with minimal tissue disruption

From contouring to controlled retraction, the Malleable Ribbon Retractor offers reliable support exactly when and where it’s needed.
